sourceTitle: Mango lassi - Navratri vrat special recipe
sourceText:
Mango lassi - Navratri vrat special recipe
By: snapcook
Published: Wednesday, March 29, 2017 - 11:30am

Ingredients




Chopped Mango slices – 1 cup.
Sugar – 2 Tbsp.
Curd / Yogurt- 1 cup
Chopped Almonds and Cashew nuts – 2 Tbsp.

Preparation

1 Take 1 cup chopped Mangoes. 2 Add the chopped mangoes in a blender or mixer. 3 Add 2Tbsp sugar and blend for 1-2 mins. 4 Add 1 cup curd or yogurt and blend again for 1-2 mins. 5 Take 2-3 Almonds and cashew nuts and chop them in small pieces. 6 Add some malai or milk cream on top of the lassi. 7 Add chopped dry fruits on top of the mango lassi.

About

This navratri vrat lets give a sweet twist to our conventional lassi.
